source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of finally and else (PDF 61).

blocks.text: finally block hamesha chalta hai, exception (ghalti) aaye ya na aaye. else block (agar likha ho) sirf tab chalta hai jab try mein koi ghalti na aaye. Is se kuch code har haal mein chalaya ja sakta hai, aur ghalti na hone par alag kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh code bikhra hua chhapa hai: kai lines ke tukre alag alag columns mein hain (maslan "Ent er a", "number" aur ""))" alag, "f inally" toota hua). Oopar tukron ko sahi order mein jor kar code diya gaya hai.

items: User 5 likhe: try bina ghalti ke chalta hai, else chalta hai ("The result is 2.0"), phir finally ("Execution completed.").
User 0 likhe: ZeroDivisionError, "You can’t divide by zero ! ", phir finally.
User abc likhe: int() ValueError deta hai, "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number.", phir finally.

blocks.text: Yani else sirf ghalti na hone par chal kar division ka result dikhata hai, aur finally har haal mein aakhri message print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: User abc likhe to kya print hota hai?
blocks.explanation: "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." aur phir "Execution completed."

items: else: ghalti na ho to; finally: hamesha.
Kai except blocks alag ghaltiyan sambhalte hain.
